compiled_state.title: Add comment-marker idempotency guard to calibration-report.sh monthly subcommand
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-3: Repeated invocation of calibration-report.sh monthly for the same period does not produce a duplicate comment on the tracking ticket

## Implementation
Extend plugins/dso/scripts/calibration-report.sh monthly subcommand so that, before posting, it queries existing comments on the calibration-program-health tracking ticket via `${DSO} ticket show <id>` and greps for an existing HTML-comment marker matching `<!-- calibration-rollup: period=YYYY-MM kind=monthly -->`. If found, exits 0 with a 'skipping: rollup already posted for YYYY-MM' notice on stderr.

The `--dry-run` path remains a no-op for idempotency (always prints; no state lookup).

Extend tests/scripts/test-calibration-report.sh with a test that:
1. Sets up a mock DSO state where calibration-program-health already has a comment with the marker
2. Invokes monthly for the same period
3. Asserts the second invocation produces no additional comment (mock DSO receives no new `ticket comment` call)

## TDD Test Spec
Given: mock DSO state where calibration-program-health already has one comment containing '<!-- calibration-rollup: period=2026-04 kind=monthly -->'
When: calibration-report.sh monthly is invoked a second time for period 2026-04 against the same fixture
Then: no additional `ticket comment` call is made to mock DSO AND script exits 0 AND 'skipping' or 'already posted' appears in stderr output

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] Idempotency test function exists in test file
  Verify: grep -qE 'test.*idempot|test.*skip|test.*duplicate' tests/scripts/test-calibration-report.sh
- [ ] Idempotency behavioral test passes (dd-3)
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-calibration-report.sh
- [ ] Script source contains idempotency check referencing the comment marker
  Verify: grep -qE 'calibration-rollup.*period.*kind' plugins/dso/scripts/calibration-report.sh
- [ ] Script skips posting and exits 0 when a duplicate marker is found (verified by test suite passing with 0 failures)
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-calibration-report.sh 2>&1 | tail -2 | grep -qE 'FAILED: 0'
- [ ] task-1's existing monthly correctness tests continue to pass
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-calibration-report.sh 2>&1 | tail -2 | grep -qE 'FAILED: 0'

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet->opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately

comments.body: AC amendment: Idempotency guard must specify marker uniqueness scope (period + subcommand). The HTML-comment marker must encode both the subcommand kind and the specific period, e.g., <!-- calibration-rollup: period=2026-05 kind=monthly --> NOT a generic sentinel. The idempotency check must match on the full key (period AND kind), not just a prefix, so that monthly and quarterly markers for the same calendar window do not collide or falsely suppress each other. Taxonomy: implicit_assumption.
